glossary.definition: (1) "Child care center" has the same meaning as in section 5104.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2950.034 - Prohibiting offender from establishing residence near school, child care facility.

glossary.definition: (2) "Children's crisis care facility" has the same meaning as in section 5103.13 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2950.034 - Prohibiting offender from establishing residence near school, child care facility.
Section 2950.034 - Prohibiting offender from establishing residence near school, child care facility.

glossary.definition: (4) "Preschool" means any public or private institution or center that provides early childhood instructional or educational services to children who are at least three years of age but less than six years of age and who are not enrolled in or are not eligible to be enrolled in kindergarten, whether or not those services are provided in a child care setting. "Preschool" does not include any place that is the permanent residence of the person who is providing the early childhood instructional or educational services to the children described in this division.
glossary.source_title: Section 2950.034 - Prohibiting offender from establishing residence near school, child care facility.

glossary.term: Preschool or child care center premises

glossary.definition: (6) "Residential infant care center" has the same meaning as in section 5103.60 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2950.034 - Prohibiting offender from establishing residence near school, child care facility.

glossary.definition:
(7) "Residential infant care center premises" means both of the following:

(a) The parcel of real property on which any residential infant care center is situated;

(b) Any grounds, play areas, and other facilities of a residential infant care center that are regularly used by the children served by the center.
